translations.web: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
translations.bsb: Many have undertaken to compose an account of the things that have been fulfilled among us,
translations.kjv: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,
